_comment: ROOT package.json — Database & infrastructure tooling ONLY.
The Expo/React Native app lives in client/ with its own package.json.
This file exists solely to manage the Supabase CLI for migrations.
name: grocery-infra

scripts._comment_scripts: All db:* scripts source .env for SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN automatically
scripts.db:push: export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && npx supabase db push
scripts.db:status: export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && npx supabase migration list
scripts.db:reset: export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && npx supabase db reset
scripts.db:diff: export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && npx supabase db diff
scripts.db:types: export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs) && npx supabase gen types typescript --linked > client/lib/database.types.ts
